<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
  <title>Cursor Grok 4.6</title>
  <style>
    * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
    html, body {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      overflow: hidden;
      background: #050814;
    }
    canvas {
      display: block;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <canvas id="c"></canvas>
  <script>
(function () {
  "use strict";

  const canvas = document.getElementById("c");
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d", { alpha: false });

  const CYCLE = 17.5;
  const SMOKE_MAX = 280;
  const EMBER_MAX = 64;
  const RIPPLE_MAX = 18;

  let W = 0, H = 0, dpr = 1;
  let start = performance.now();
  let lastNow = start;
  let lastCycleT = 0;

  const smokeSprites = [];
  let emberSprite = null;
  let sparkSprite = null;

  const smoke = new Array(SMOKE_MAX);
  const embers = new Array(EMBER_MAX);
  const ripples = new Array(RIPPLE_MAX);
  const stars = [];
  const clouds = [];
  const palms = [];
  const veg = [];
  const rocks = [];

  function mulberry32(seed) {
    return function () {
      seed |= 0;
      seed = (seed + 0x6d2b79f5) | 0;
      let t = Math.imul(seed ^ (seed >>> 15), 1 | seed);
      t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t;
      return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
    };
  }

  function makeSmokeSprite(r, g, b, a0) {
    const s = document.createElement("canvas");
    s.width = 64;
    s.height = 64;
    const c = s.getContext("2d");
    const grd = c.createRadialGradient(32, 32, 2, 32, 32, 30);
    grd.addColorStop(0, "rgba(" + r + "," + g + "," + b + "," + a0 + ")");
    grd.addColorStop(0.32, "rgba(" + r + "," + g + "," + b + "," + (a0 * 0.55) + ")");
    grd.addColorStop(0.68, "rgba(" + r + "," + g + "," + b + "," + (a0 * 0.18) + ")");
    grd.addColorStop(1, "rgba(" + r + "," + g + "," + b + ",0)");
    c.fillStyle = grd;
    c.fillRect(0, 0, 64, 64);
    return s;
  }

  function makeGlowSprite(r, g, b, size) {
    const s = document.createElement("canvas");
    s.width = size;
    s.height = size;
    const c = s.getContext("2d");
    const m = size / 2;
    const grd = c.createRadialGradient(m, m, 0, m, m, m);
    grd.addColorStop(0, "rgba(" + r + "," + g + "," + b + ",1)");
    grd.addColorStop(0.35, "rgba(" + r + "," + g + "," + b + ",0.55)");
    grd.addColorStop(1, "rgba(" + r + "," + g + "," + b + ",0)");
    c.fillStyle = grd;
    c.fillRect(0, 0, size, size);
    return s;
  }

  function initSprites() {
    smokeSprites.length = 0;
    smokeSprites.push(makeSmokeSprite(245, 245, 248, 0.82));
    smokeSprites.push(makeSmokeSprite(210, 208, 204, 0.78));
    smokeSprites.push(makeSmokeSprite(160, 156, 150, 0.72));
    smokeSprites.push(makeSmokeSprite(120, 118, 114, 0.68));
    smokeSprites.push(makeSmokeSprite(255, 236, 210, 0.55));
    emberSprite = makeGlowSprite(255, 170, 40, 16);
    sparkSprite = makeGlowSprite(255, 240, 180, 12);
  }

  function resetPool(pool, n, factory) {
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) pool[i] = factory();
  }

  function smokeParticle() {
    return {
      alive: false, x: 0, y: 0, vx: 0, vy: 0,
      r: 10, growth: 18, life: 0, maxLife: 2,
      rot: 0, rotv: 0, sprite: 1, drag: 0.985, wind: 0, layer: 0
    };
  }

  function emberParticle() {
    return {
      alive: false, x: 0, y: 0, vx: 0, vy: 0,
      life: 0, maxLife: 1, size: 3, g: 80
    };
  }

  function rippleParticle() {
    return { alive: false, x: 0, y: 0, r: 4, vr: 22, life: 0, maxLife: 2.2 };
  }

  function spawnFrom(pool, apply) {
    for (let i = 0; i < pool.length; i++) {
      if (!pool[i].alive) {
        apply(pool[i]);
        pool[i].alive = true;
        return pool[i];
      }
    }
    return null;
  }

  function layout() {
    return {
      horizon: H * 0.575,
      islandX: W * 0.48,
      islandY: H * 0.73,
      islandRx: Math.min(W * 0.28, 340),
      islandRy: Math.min(H * 0.095, 88),
      padX: W * 0.475,
      padY: H * 0.705,
      towerX: W * 0.475 + 58
    };
  }

  function seedWorld() {
    const rng = mulberry32(0xC0DE46);
    stars.length = 0;
    const starCount = Math.floor(90 + W * 0.08);
    for (let i = 0; i < starCount; i++) {
      stars.push({
        x: rng(),
        y: rng() * 0.48,
        s: 0.4 + rng() * 1.6,
        ph: rng() * Math.PI * 2,
        sp: 0.6 + rng() * 2.4,
        a: 0.35 + rng() * 0.65
      });
    }
    clouds.length = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
      clouds.push({
        x: rng() * 1.2 - 0.1,
        y: 0.08 + rng() * 0.32,
        s: 0.55 + rng() * 0.9,
        sp: 0.003 + rng() * 0.006,
        tint: rng()
      });
    }
    palms.length = 0;
    palms.push({ side: -1, ox: -0.62, oy: 0.15, sc: 1.05, ph: 0.2 });
    palms.push({ side: 1, ox: 0.72, oy: 0.28, sc: 0.88, ph: 1.4 });
    palms.push({ side: -1, ox: -0.28, oy: 0.42, sc: 0.72, ph: 2.6 });
    veg.length = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < 28; i++) {
      veg.push({
        a: rng() * Math.PI * 2,
        d: 0.15 + rng() * 0.78,
        r: 8 + rng() * 22,
        g: 70 + rng() * 70,
        shade: rng()
      });
    }
    rocks.length = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
      rocks.push({
        a: rng() * Math.PI * 2,
        d: 0.55 + rng() * 0.4,
        w: 7 + rng() * 16,
        h: 4 + rng() * 8
      });
    }
  }

  function resize() {
    dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
    W = window.innerWidth;
    H = window.innerHeight;
    canvas.width = Math.floor(W * dpr);
    canvas.height = Math.floor(H * dpr);
    canvas.style.width = W + "px";
    canvas.style.height = H + "px";
    seedWorld();
  }

  function smootherstep(t) {
    t = t < 0 ? 0 : t > 1 ? 1 : t;
    return t * t * t * (t * (t * 6 - 15) + 10);
  }

  function rocketMotion(t, L) {
    const padY = L.padY - 6;
    const offY = -H * 0.55;
    const fit = Math.min(1.2, Math.max(0.72, H / 860));
    let y = padY;
    let scale = fit;
    let thrusting = false;
    let ignite = 0;
    let shake = 0;
    let visible = true;

    if (t < 1.5) {
      thrusting = t > 0.28;
      ignite = t < 0.28 ? 0 : Math.min(1, (t - 0.28) / 0.45);
      shake = ignite * (2.2 + (t > 1.1 ? 1.4 : 0));
    } else if (t < 7) {
      thrusting = true;
      ignite = 1;
      const u = t - 1.5;
      const alt = 22 * u * u + 4 * u * u * u + 16 * u;
      y = padY - alt;
      scale = fit * Math.max(0.42, 1 - alt / (H * 1.55));
      shake = u < 2.6 ? 3.4 * (1 - u / 2.6) : 0.6;
    } else if (t < 12) {
      y = offY;
      scale = fit * 0.42;
      visible = false;
      shake = 0;
    } else if (t < 16.4) {
      const p = smootherstep((t - 12) / 4.4);
      y = offY + (padY - offY) * p;
      scale = fit * (0.42 + 0.58 * p);
      visible = true;
      shake = 0;
    } else {
      y = padY;
      scale = fit;
      visible = true;
    }

    return { x: L.padX, y: y, scale: scale, thrusting: thrusting, ignite: ignite, shake: shake, visible: visible };
  }

  function spawnLaunchFx(t, dt, rocket, L) {
    const thrusting = rocket.thrusting;
    const ex = rocket.x;
    const ey = rocket.y + 4 * rocket.scale;
    const sc = rocket.scale;

    if (t > 0.35 && t < 6.8) {
      const nRip = t < 4.2 ? 0.35 : 0.08;
      if (Math.random() < nRip * dt * 60) {
        spawnFrom(ripples, function (p) {
          p.x = L.islandX + (Math.random() - 0.5) * L.islandRx * 1.6;
          p.y = L.islandY + L.islandRy * (0.35 + Math.random() * 0.5);
          p.r = 6 + Math.random() * 10;
          p.vr = 18 + Math.random() * 16;
          p.life = 0;
          p.maxLife = 1.6 + Math.random() * 1.1;
        });
      }
    }

    if (!thrusting) return;

    const pre = t < 1.5;
    const lift = t >= 1.5 && t < 4;
    const ascent = t >= 4 && t < 7;
    const thin = t >= 6.2;

    let baseN = 0, trailN = 0, emberN = 0;
    if (pre) {
      baseN = 6;
      emberN = 2;
    } else if (lift) {
      baseN = 9;
      trailN = 4;
      emberN = 4;
    } else if (ascent) {
      baseN = thin ? 1 : 3;
      trailN = thin ? 2 : 5;
      emberN = thin ? 1 : 3;
    }

    for (let i = 0; i < baseN; i++) {
      const ang = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
      const spread = pre ? 40 + Math.random() * 70 : 55 + Math.random() * 110;
      const mushroom = lift && Math.random() < 0.55;
      spawnFrom(smoke, function (p) {
        p.x = ex + Math.cos(ang) * (8 + Math.random() * 18) * sc;
        p.y = ey + 6 + Math.random() * 10;
        p.vx = Math.cos(ang) * spread * (0.35 + Math.random() * 0.7) + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 12;
        p.vy = mushroom
          ? -18 - Math.random() * 42
          : (pre ? -6 - Math.random() * 14 : -8 - Math.random() * 22);
        if (pre) p.vy *= 0.45;
        p.r = (mushroom ? 22 : 14) + Math.random() * 18;
        p.growth = 28 + Math.random() * 48;
        p.life = 0;
        p.maxLife = 2.2 + Math.random() * 2.4;
        p.rot = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
        p.rotv = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.7;
        p.sprite = t < 2.2 && Math.random() < 0.25 ? 4 : (Math.random() < 0.45 ? 0 : (Math.random() < 0.5 ? 1 : 2));
        p.drag = 0.978 + Math.random() * 0.012;
        p.wind = 6 + Math.random() * 10;
        p.layer = 0;
      });
    }

    for (let i = 0; i < trailN; i++) {
      spawnFrom(smoke, function (p) {
        p.x = ex + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 22 * sc;
        p.y = ey + 10 + Math.random() * 28;
        p.vx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 22;
        p.vy = 8 + Math.random() * 26;
        p.r = 8 + Math.random() * 12;
        p.growth = 16 + Math.random() * 28;
        p.life = 0;
        p.maxLife = 1.6 + Math.random() * 1.8;
        p.rot = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
        p.rotv = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.9;
        p.sprite = Math.random() < 0.3 ? 0 : (Math.random() < 0.5 ? 1 : 3);
        p.drag = 0.982;
        p.wind = 8 + Math.random() * 8;
        p.layer = 1;
      });
    }

    for (let i = 0; i < emberN; i++) {
      const a = Math.PI * 0.5 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.4;
      const sp = 40 + Math.random() * 120;
      spawnFrom(embers, function (p) {
        p.x = ex + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 16 * sc;
        p.y = ey + 8;
        p.vx = Math.cos(a) * sp * (Math.random() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1) * 0.35 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 80;
        p.vy = 30 + Math.random() * 90;
        p.life = 0;
        p.maxLife = 0.45 + Math.random() * 0.7;
        p.size = 1.2 + Math.random() * 2.8;
        p.g = 90 + Math.random() * 80;
      });
    }
  }

  function updateParticles(dt, t) {
    const breeze = 14 + Math.sin(t * 0.35) * 6;
    for (let i = 0; i < smoke.length; i++) {
      const p = smoke[i];
      if (!p.alive) continue;
      p.life += dt;
      if (p.life >= p.maxLife) {
        p.alive = false;
        continue;
      }
      const k = p.life / p.maxLife;
      p.vx += (breeze * 0.15 + Math.sin(t * 1.7 + p.rot) * p.wind * 0.12) * dt;
      p.vy -= 6 * dt;
      p.vx *= Math.pow(p.drag, dt * 60);
      p.vy *= Math.pow(p.drag, dt * 60);
      p.x += p.vx * dt;
      p.y += p.vy * dt;
      p.rot += p.rotv * dt;
      p._k = k;
      p._size = p.r + p.growth * (0.25 + 0.75 * k);
      p._a = k < 0.1 ? k / 0.1 : 1 - (k - 0.1) / 0.9;
      p._a *= 0.92;
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < embers.length; i++) {
      const p = embers[i];
      if (!p.alive) continue;
      p.life += dt;
      if (p.life >= p.maxLife) {
        p.alive = false;
        continue;
      }
      p.vy += p.g * dt;
      p.vx *= 0.98;
      p.x += p.vx * dt;
      p.y += p.vy * dt;
      p._k = p.life / p.maxLife;
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < ripples.length; i++) {
      const p = ripples[i];
      if (!p.alive) continue;
      p.life += dt;
      if (p.life >= p.maxLife) {
        p.alive = false;
        continue;
      }
      p.r += p.vr * dt;
      p._k = p.life / p.maxLife;
    }
  }

  function drawSky(L, t) {
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, L.horizon + 8);
    g.addColorStop(0, "#05060f");
    g.addColorStop(0.18, "#0b1230");
    g.addColorStop(0.42, "#1c2a62");
    g.addColorStop(0.62, "#5a3d7a");
    g.addColorStop(0.78, "#c45c48");
    g.addColorStop(0.9, "#f08a4b");
    g.addColorStop(1, "#ffc17a");
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    const sun = ctx.createRadialGradient(W * 0.52, L.horizon + 10, 4, W * 0.52, L.horizon + 10, W * 0.48);
    sun.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255, 210, 120, 0.7)");
    sun.addColorStop(0.18, "rgba(255, 140, 70, 0.28)");
    sun.addColorStop(0.5, "rgba(180, 70, 90, 0.08)");
    sun.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");
    ctx.fillStyle = sun;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, L.horizon + 20);

    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(W * 0.52, L.horizon + 6, 22, Math.PI, 0);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffd9a0";
    ctx.fill();
    const halo = ctx.createRadialGradient(W * 0.52, L.horizon + 4, 8, W * 0.52, L.horizon + 4, 70);
    halo.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255, 220, 160, 0.45)");
    halo.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255, 180, 80, 0)");
    ctx.fillStyle = halo;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(W * 0.52, L.horizon + 4, 70, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  function drawStars(L, t) {
    for (let i = 0; i < stars.length; i++) {
      const s = stars[i];
      const y = s.y * L.horizon;
      const fade = 1 - Math.min(1, y / (L.horizon * 0.55));
      if (fade <= 0.05) continue;
      const tw = 0.55 + 0.45 * Math.sin(t * s.sp + s.ph);
      ctx.globalAlpha = s.a * fade * tw;
      ctx.fillStyle = "#e8eeff";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(s.x * W, y, s.s, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function drawCloud(cx, cy, sc, tint, t) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(cx, cy);
    ctx.scale(sc, sc * 0.62);
    const warm = 0.25 + tint * 0.5;
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(" + Math.floor(255 - warm * 30) + "," + Math.floor(228 - warm * 50) + "," + Math.floor(210 - warm * 20) + ",0.32)";
    const blobs = [
      [0, 0, 48], [-38, 8, 32], [40, 10, 30], [-18, -14, 26], [22, -12, 24], [8, 14, 28]
    ];
    ctx.beginPath();
    for (let i = 0; i < blobs.length; i++) {
      ctx.moveTo(blobs[i][0] + blobs[i][2], blobs[i][1]);
      ctx.arc(blobs[i][0], blobs[i][1], blobs[i][2], 0, Math.PI * 2);
    }
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawClouds(L, t) {
    for (let i = 0; i < clouds.length; i++) {
      const c = clouds[i];
      let x = ((c.x + t * c.sp) % 1.4) - 0.2;
      drawCloud(x * W, c.y * L.horizon, c.s * (0.7 + W / 1800), c.tint, t);
    }
  }

  function drawOcean(L, t, rocket) {
    const top = L.horizon;
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, top, 0, H);
    g.addColorStop(0, "#6aa0c4");
    g.addColorStop(0.08, "#2d5f86");
    g.addColorStop(0.35, "#143a58");
    g.addColorStop(1, "#071422");
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(0, top - 2, W, H - top + 2);

    ctx.save();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.rect(0, top - 4, W, 28);
    ctx.clip();
    const rg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, top - 4, 0, top + 22);
    rg.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255, 190, 120, 0.28)");
    rg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255, 140, 70, 0)");
    ctx.fillStyle = rg;
    ctx.fillRect(0, top - 4, W, 28);
    ctx.restore();

    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(180, 220, 255, 0.12)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
    for (let k = 0; k < 5; k++) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      const y0 = top + 18 + k * ((H - top) / 6);
      for (let x = 0; x <= W; x += 10) {
        const y = y0 + Math.sin(x * 0.018 + t * 1.3 + k) * (2.2 + k * 0.4)
          + Math.sin(x * 0.041 + t * 1.9 + k * 1.7) * 1.2;
        if (x === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y);
        else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
      }
      ctx.stroke();
    }

    if (rocket.ignite > 0.05 && rocket.y > L.horizon * 0.35) {
      const glow = ctx.createRadialGradient(L.padX, L.islandY + 8, 4, L.padX, L.islandY + 8, 160);
      const a = 0.22 * rocket.ignite * (rocket.thrusting ? 1 : 0.15);
      glow.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255, 160, 40, " + a + ")");
      glow.addColorStop(0.45, "rgba(255, 90, 20, " + a * 0.35 + ")");
      glow.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255, 80, 0, 0)");
      ctx.fillStyle = glow;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(L.padX, L.islandY + 10, 170, 36, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }

    for (let i = 0; i < ripples.length; i++) {
      const p = ripples[i];
      if (!p.alive) continue;
      const a = (1 - p._k) * 0.28;
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(230, 245, 255, " + a + ")";
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.4 * (1 - p._k);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(p.x, p.y, p.r, p.r * 0.28, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  }

  function drawIsland(L, t) {
    const { islandX: cx, islandY: cy, islandRx: rx, islandRy: ry } = L;

    ctx.save();
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(4, 18, 28, 0.45)";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(cx + 8, cy + 16, rx * 1.08, ry * 0.85, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();

    ctx.beginPath();
    const n = 10;
    for (let i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
      const a = (i / n) * Math.PI * 2 - Math.PI / 2;
      const wob = 1 + Math.sin(a * 3) * 0.07 + Math.cos(a * 5.2) * 0.045;
      const px = cx + Math.cos(a) * rx * wob;
      const py = cy + Math.sin(a) * ry * wob;
      if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(px, py);
      else ctx.lineTo(px, py);
    }
    ctx.closePath();
    const sand = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy - ry * 0.2, 10, cx, cy, rx);
    sand.addColorStop(0, "#e8c98a");
    sand.addColorStop(0.45, "#d4b06a");
    sand.addColorStop(0.78, "#c9a056");
    sand.addColorStop(1, "#a67c42");
    ctx.fillStyle = sand;
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(cx, cy + 2, rx * 0.78, ry * 0.68, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    const grass = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx - 10, cy - 8, 8, cx, cy, rx * 0.8);
    grass.addColorStop(0, "#4a8a3a");
    grass.addColorStop(0.5, "#2f6a28");
    grass.addColorStop(1, "#1e4a1c");
    ctx.fillStyle = grass;
    ctx.fill();

    for (let i = 0; i < veg.length; i++) {
      const v = veg[i];
      const x = cx + Math.cos(v.a) * rx * 0.72 * v.d;
      const y = cy + Math.sin(v.a) * ry * 0.62 * v.d;
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(" + (30 + v.shade * 40) + "," + v.g + "," + (24 + v.shade * 20) + ",0.85)";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(x, y, v.r, v.r * 0.55, v.a, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }

    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.28)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(cx, cy + 1, rx * 0.97, ry * 0.92, 0, 0.15, Math.PI - 0.15);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(cx, cy + 3, rx * 0.9, ry * 0.82, 0, 0.2, Math.PI - 0.2);
    ctx.stroke();

    for (let i = 0; i < rocks.length; i++) {
      const r = rocks[i];
      const x = cx + Math.cos(r.a) * rx * r.d;
      const y = cy + Math.sin(r.a) * ry * r.d * 0.85;
      ctx.fillStyle = "#6b5a4a";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(x, y, r.w, r.h, r.a, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.12)";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(x - 1, y - 1, r.w * 0.4, r.h * 0.35, r.a, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }

  function drawPalm(x, y, sc, t, ph) {
    const sway = Math.sin(t * 1.05 + ph) * 0.14;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(x, y);
    ctx.scale(sc, sc);
    ctx.rotate(sway * 0.15);

    ctx.strokeStyle = "#6b4423";
    ctx.fillStyle = "#8a5a2b";
    ctx.lineWidth = 7;
    ctx.lineCap = "round";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, 0);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(6 + sway * 20, -36, sway * 40, -78);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#c48a4a";
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-1, 0);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(4 + sway * 20, -36, sway * 40 - 2, -78);
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.translate(sway * 40, -78);
    ctx.rotate(sway);
    const fronds = 7;
    for (let i = 0; i < fronds; i++) {
      const a = -Math.PI * 0.85 + (i / (fronds - 1)) * Math.PI * 1.7;
      ctx.save();
      ctx.rotate(a);
      ctx.fillStyle = i % 2 === 0 ? "#1f6b28" : "#2d8a34";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(0, 0);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(18, -7, 42, 2 + Math.sin(t * 2 + i) * 2);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(18, 6, 0, 0);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(180, 255, 140, 0.25)";
      ctx.lineWidth = 0.8;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(0, 0);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(18, -2, 40, 2);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.restore();
    }
    ctx.fillStyle = "#3d7a22";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, 0, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawPalms(L, t) {
    for (let i = 0; i < palms.length; i++) {
      const p = palms[i];
      const x = L.islandX + p.ox * L.islandRx;
      const y = L.islandY + p.oy * L.islandRy;
      drawPalm(x, y, p.sc * (0.85 + L.islandRx / 400), t, p.ph);
    }
  }

  function drawPad(L, t, rocket) {
    const x = L.padX;
    const y = L.padY + 10;

    ctx.fillStyle = "#5a5854";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(x, y + 6, 54, 16, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.fillStyle = "#8a8680";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x - 48, y);
    ctx.lineTo(x + 48, y);
    ctx.lineTo(x + 40, y + 14);
    ctx.lineTo(x - 40, y + 14);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.fillStyle = "#3a3836";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(x, y + 2, 22, 7, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.strokeStyle = "#d4a017";
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    ctx.setLineDash([6, 4]);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(x, y + 4, 38, 10, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.setLineDash([]);

    ctx.fillStyle = "#2a2826";
    ctx.fillRect(x - 16, y - 4, 32, 5);

    if (rocket.ignite > 0) {
      const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(x, y, 2, x, y, 40);
      g.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255, 200, 80, " + (0.55 * rocket.ignite) + ")");
      g.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255, 80, 0, 0)");
      ctx.fillStyle = g;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(x, y, 40, 12, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }

  function drawTower(L, t) {
    const x = L.towerX;
    const base = L.padY + 12;
    const top = L.padY - 300;
    const w = 22;

    ctx.save();
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#6d7380";
    ctx.fillStyle = "#4a5160";
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;

    ctx.fillRect(x - w / 2, top, 4, base - top);
    ctx.fillRect(x + w / 2 - 4, top, 4, base - top);

    ctx.strokeStyle = "#8a93a3";
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
    for (let y = top + 18; y < base - 8; y += 22) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x - w / 2, y);
      ctx.lineTo(x + w / 2, y);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x - w / 2, y);
      ctx.lineTo(x + w / 2, y + 22);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x + w / 2, y);
      ctx.lineTo(x - w / 2, y + 22);
      ctx.stroke();
    }

    ctx.fillStyle = "#3d4452";
    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
      const py = top + 36 + i * 52;
      ctx.fillRect(x - w / 2 - 8, py, w + 16, 5);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#c45c28";
      ctx.fillRect(x - w / 2 - 8, py, 4, 5);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#3d4452";
    }

    ctx.fillStyle = "#2c3340";
    ctx.fillRect(x - 6, top - 28, 4, 32);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x - 4, top - 30, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#8892a4";
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.fillStyle = "#d4a017";
    ctx.fillRect(x - w / 2 - 2, base - 18, w + 4, 6);
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function roundRectPath(x, y, w, h, r) {
    const rr = Math.min(r, w / 2, h / 2);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + rr, y);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, rr);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, rr);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, rr);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, rr);
    ctx.closePath();
  }

  function bodyShade(x0, x1, c0, c1, c2) {
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(x0, 0, x1, 0);
    g.addColorStop(0, c0);
    g.addColorStop(0.28, c1);
    g.addColorStop(0.72, c2);
    g.addColorStop(1, c0);
    return g;
  }

  function drawEngineBell(ox, oy, s) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(ox, oy);
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(-s, 0, s, 0);
    g.addColorStop(0, "#5a3a22");
    g.addColorStop(0.3, "#c48a48");
    g.addColorStop(0.55, "#f0d090");
    g.addColorStop(1, "#6a4428");
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-s * 0.42, -s * 0.9);
    ctx.lineTo(s * 0.42, -s * 0.9);
    ctx.lineTo(s * 0.95, s * 0.85);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(0, s * 1.15, -s * 0.95, s * 0.85);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#1a0e08";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, s * 0.72, s * 0.72, s * 0.22, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255, 200, 120, 0.25)";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, s * 0.62, s * 0.35, s * 0.1, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawRocket(x, y, scale, t, thrusting, ignite) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(x, y);
    ctx.scale(scale, scale);

    const bw = 38;
    const hw = bw / 2;

    const fins = [
      { x: 0, z: 1 },
      { x: 0, z: -1 },
      { x: 1, z: 0 },
      { x: -1, z: 0 }
    ];
    for (let i = 0; i < fins.length; i++) {
      const f = fins[i];
      if (f.z < 0) continue;
      ctx.save();
      ctx.fillStyle = f.x === 0 ? "#1c1e24" : "#2a2d36";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(f.x * (hw - 2), -38);
      ctx.lineTo(f.x * (hw + 22), -8);
      ctx.lineTo(f.x * (hw + 18), 4);
      ctx.lineTo(f.x * (hw - 2), -18);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.18)";
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.restore();
    }

    const positions = [
      [0, 0], [-11, 3], [11, 3], [-7, 8], [7, 8],
      [-18, 6], [18, 6], [0, 9], [-14, -1], [14, -1]
    ];
    for (let i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
      drawEngineBell(positions[i][0] * 0.85, positions[i][1] + 8, 7.4);
    }

    ctx.fillStyle = "#1a1c22";
    roundRectPath(-hw - 1, -42, bw + 2, 28, 3);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = bodyShade(-hw, hw, "#2a2e38", "#4a5160", "#6a7384");
    roundRectPath(-hw, -40, bw, 22, 2);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.fillStyle = bodyShade(-hw, hw, "#c8c0b4", "#f4efe6", "#ffffff");
    roundRectPath(-hw, -186, bw, 146, 2);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(40, 36, 32, 0.18)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 0.7;
    for (let yb = -180; yb < -44; yb += 11) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(-hw + 2, yb);
      ctx.lineTo(hw - 2, yb);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-6, -184);
    ctx.lineTo(-6, -44);
    ctx.moveTo(8, -184);
    ctx.lineTo(8, -44);
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(30, 28, 26, 0.28)";
    for (let yb = -176; yb < -48; yb += 22) {
      for (let k = 0; k < 5; k++) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(-hw + 6 + k * 7, yb, 0.7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
      }
    }

    ctx.fillStyle = "#1a1c22";
    ctx.fillRect(-hw, -92, bw, 10);
    ctx.fillRect(-hw, -148, bw, 7);
    ctx.fillStyle = bodyShade(-hw, hw, "#0e1014", "#2a2e38", "#3a404c");
    ctx.fillRect(-hw + 1, -91, bw - 2, 8);

    ctx.fillStyle = "#c45c28";
    ctx.fillRect(-hw, -168, bw, 14);
    ctx.fillStyle = bodyShade(-hw, hw, "#8a3518", "#e07038", "#ffb078");
    ctx.fillRect(-hw + 1, -167, bw - 2, 12);

    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(0, -161);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#f4efe6";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, -5);
    ctx.lineTo(4.5, 4);
    ctx.lineTo(-4.5, 4);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.5)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 0.8;
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();

    ctx.fillStyle = "#1d4a8c";
    ctx.fillRect(-hw + 6, -132, 11, 8);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#c43c2c";
    ctx.fillRect(-hw + 6, -128, 11, 1.4);
    ctx.fillRect(-hw + 6, -125.2, 11, 1.4);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#f4efe6";
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
      ctx.fillRect(-hw + 7 + (i % 2) * 3, -131 + Math.floor(i / 2) * 2, 1.2, 1.2);
    }

    ctx.strokeStyle = "#3a3e48";
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(10, -110, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(7, -110);
    ctx.lineTo(13, -110);
    ctx.moveTo(10, -113);
    ctx.lineTo(10, -107);
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.fillStyle = "#2a2e36";
    roundRectPath(hw - 7, -180, 6, 132, 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.12)";
    ctx.fillRect(hw - 6, -178, 2, 128);

    ctx.fillStyle = "#1a1c22";
    roundRectPath(-hw - 1, -214, bw + 2, 16, 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = bodyShade(-hw, hw, "#2a303c", "#4a5468", "#6a7890");
    roundRectPath(-hw, -212, bw, 12, 1);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.35)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 0.6;
    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(-hw + 4 + i * 6, -212);
      ctx.lineTo(-hw + 4 + i * 6, -200);
      ctx.stroke();
    }

    ctx.fillStyle = bodyShade(-hw + 1, hw - 1, "#c8c0b4", "#f4efe6", "#ffffff");
    roundRectPath(-hw + 1, -268, bw - 2, 56, 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(40, 36, 32, 0.16)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 0.7;
    for (let yb = -262; yb < -216; yb += 10) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(-hw + 4, yb);
      ctx.lineTo(hw - 4, yb);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    ctx.fillStyle = "#1a1c22";
    ctx.fillRect(-hw + 1, -236, bw - 2, 5);

    ctx.fillStyle = "#4a90c4";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, -250, 3.2, 4.5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.45)";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(-0.8, -251, 1.2, 1.6, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.fillStyle = "#2a2e36";
    ctx.fillRect(hw - 8, -258, 4, 6);
    ctx.fillRect(-hw + 4, -258, 4, 6);

    const fairing = ctx.createLinearGradient(-hw, 0, hw, 0);
    fairing.addColorStop(0, "#2a3038");
    fairing.addColorStop(0.3, "#5a6574");
    fairing.addColorStop(0.7, "#8a96a8");
    fairing.addColorStop(1, "#3a4450");
    ctx.fillStyle = fairing;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-hw + 1, -268);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-hw + 2, -300, -8, -328);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(0, -338, 8, -328);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(hw - 2, -300, hw - 1, -268);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.25)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 0.8;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, -268);
    ctx.lineTo(0, -332);
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.fillStyle = "#c45c28";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-6, -326);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(0, -340, 6, -326);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(0, -332, -6, -326);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255, 160, 80, 0.35)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-hw, -40);
    ctx.lineTo(-hw, -268);
    ctx.stroke();

    function gridFin(side) {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(side * (hw + 1), -190);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#2c313c";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.rect(0, -11, side * 17, 22);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = "#8a93a3";
      ctx.lineWidth = 0.7;
      ctx.stroke();
      for (let g = 0; g < 5; g++) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(side * 1.5, -9 + g * 4.5);
        ctx.lineTo(side * 15.5, -9 + g * 4.5);
        ctx.stroke();
      }
      for (let g = 0; g < 4; g++) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(side * (3.5 + g * 3.5), -10);
        ctx.lineTo(side * (3.5 + g * 3.5), 10);
        ctx.stroke();
      }
      ctx.restore();
    }
    gridFin(-1);
    gridFin(1);

    ctx.fillStyle = "#1c1e24";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-hw + 2, -38);
    ctx.lineTo(-hw - 20, -8);
    ctx.lineTo(-hw - 16, 4);
    ctx.lineTo(-hw + 2, -18);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(hw - 2, -38);
    ctx.lineTo(hw + 20, -8);
    ctx.lineTo(hw + 16, 4);
    ctx.lineTo(hw - 2, -18);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawFlame(x, y, scale, ignite, t) {
    if (ignite <= 0.02) return;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(x, y + 8 * scale);
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = "lighter";
    const flick = 0.82 + 0.18 * Math.sin(t * 53.1) * Math.sin(t * 37.7 + 1.2);
    const flick2 = 0.85 + 0.15 * Math.sin(t * 71.4 + 0.7);
    const len = (48 + ignite * 92) * flick * scale;
    const wid = (16 + ignite * 14) * flick2 * scale;

    function plume(yy, w, h, color) {
      ctx.fillStyle = color;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(-w * 0.35, yy);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-w, yy + h * 0.35, 0, yy + h);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(w, yy + h * 0.35, w * 0.35, yy);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
    }

    plume(0, wid * 1.7, len * 1.15, "rgba(255, 40, 10, " + (0.28 * ignite) + ")");
    plume(0, wid * 1.25, len * 0.95, "rgba(255, 110, 20, " + (0.45 * ignite) + ")");
    plume(0, wid * 0.8, len * 0.72, "rgba(255, 190, 40, " + (0.7 * ignite) + ")");
    plume(0, wid * 0.42, len * 0.5, "rgba(255, 250, 210, " + (0.9 * ignite) + ")");

    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255, 255, 255, " + (0.55 * ignite * flick) + ")";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, 6 * scale, 7 * scale, 10 * scale, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
      const dy = (18 + i * 14) * scale * flick;
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255, 240, 180, " + (0.25 * ignite * flick2) + ")";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(Math.sin(t * 40 + i) * 3 * scale, dy, 4 * scale, 3 * scale, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }

    ctx.restore();
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = "source-over";
  }

  function drawHeatHaze(x, y, scale, ignite, t) {
    if (ignite < 0.2) return;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = "lighter";
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.08 * ignite;
    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
      const ox = Math.sin(t * 18 + i * 1.3) * 10 * scale;
      ctx.fillStyle = i % 2 ? "rgba(255, 180, 80, 1)" : "rgba(255, 120, 40, 1)";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(x + ox, y + 20 * scale + i * 7, 18 * scale + i * 3, 5 * scale, Math.sin(t * 9 + i) * 0.4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawSmoke(layer) {
    for (let i = 0; i < smoke.length; i++) {
      const p = smoke[i];
      if (!p.alive || p._a < 0.02 || p.layer !== layer) continue;
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(p.x, p.y);
      ctx.rotate(p.rot);
      ctx.globalAlpha = p._a;
      const spr = smokeSprites[p.sprite] || smokeSprites[1];
      const sz = p._size;
      ctx.drawImage(spr, -sz, -sz, sz * 2, sz * 2);
      ctx.restore();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function drawEmbers() {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = "lighter";
    for (let i = 0; i < embers.length; i++) {
      const p = embers[i];
      if (!p.alive) continue;
      const a = 1 - p._k;
      ctx.globalAlpha = a;
      const sz = p.size * (1.2 - p._k * 0.6);
      ctx.drawImage(emberSprite, p.x - sz * 2, p.y - sz * 2, sz * 4, sz * 4);
      ctx.drawImage(sparkSprite, p.x - sz, p.y - sz, sz * 2, sz * 2);
    }
    ctx.restore();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function drawVignette() {
    const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(W * 0.5, H * 0.45, H * 0.2, W * 0.5, H * 0.5, H * 0.78);
    g.addColorStop(0, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");
    g.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,0.42)");
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  }

  function drawTitle() {
    const text = "Cursor Grok 4.6";
    ctx.save();
    ctx.font = "600 13px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255, 244, 230, 0.62)";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    const tracking = 5.5;
    let total = 0;
    const widths = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++) {
      const w = ctx.measureText(text[i]).width + tracking;
      widths.push(w);
      total += w;
    }
    let x = W / 2 - total / 2;
    const y = 32;
    for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++) {
      ctx.fillText(text[i], x, y);
      x += widths[i];
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function killAll() {
    for (let i = 0; i < smoke.length; i++) smoke[i].alive = false;
    for (let i = 0; i < embers.length; i++) embers[i].alive = false;
    for (let i = 0; i < ripples.length; i++) ripples[i].alive = false;
  }

  function frame(now) {
    const dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - lastNow) / 1000);
    lastNow = now;
    const t = ((now - start) / 1000) % CYCLE;
    if (t < lastCycleT) killAll();
    lastCycleT = t;

    const L = layout();
    const rocket = rocketMotion(t, L);

    spawnLaunchFx(t, dt, rocket, L);
    updateParticles(dt, t);

    ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#050814";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    const sh = rocket.shake;
    const sx = sh ? (Math.random() - 0.5) * sh : 0;
    const sy = sh ? (Math.random() - 0.5) * sh : 0;

    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(sx, sy);

    drawSky(L, t);
    drawStars(L, t);
    drawClouds(L, t);
    drawOcean(L, t, rocket);
    drawIsland(L, t);
    drawPalms(L, t);
    drawTower(L, t);
    drawPad(L, t, rocket);

    drawSmoke(1);

    if (rocket.visible) {
      if (rocket.thrusting) {
        drawFlame(rocket.x, rocket.y, rocket.scale, rocket.ignite, t);
        drawHeatHaze(rocket.x, rocket.y, rocket.scale, rocket.ignite, t);
      }
      drawRocket(rocket.x, rocket.y, rocket.scale, t, rocket.thrusting, rocket.ignite);
      if (rocket.thrusting) {
        drawFlame(rocket.x, rocket.y, rocket.scale * 0.55, rocket.ignite * 0.85, t + 0.2);
      }
    }

    drawEmbers();
    drawSmoke(0);

    ctx.restore();

    drawVignette();
    drawTitle();

    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }

  initSprites();
  resetPool(smoke, SMOKE_MAX, smokeParticle);
  resetPool(embers, EMBER_MAX, emberParticle);
  resetPool(ripples, RIPPLE_MAX, rippleParticle);
  resize();
  window.addEventListener("resize", resize);
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
})();
  </script>
</body>
</html>

    * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

      width: 100%;

      display: block;

<body>
  <canvas id="c"></canvas>
  <script>
(function () {
  "use strict";

  const canvas = document.getElementById("c");
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d", { alpha: false });

  const CYCLE = 17.5;
  const SMOKE_MAX = 280;
  const EMBER_MAX = 64;
  const RIPPLE_MAX = 18;

  let W = 0, H = 0, dpr = 1;
  let start = performance.now();
  let lastNow = start;
  let lastCycleT = 0;

  const smokeSprites = [];
  let emberSprite = null;
  let sparkSprite = null;

  const smoke = new Array(SMOKE_MAX);
  const embers = new Array(EMBER_MAX);
  const ripples = new Array(RIPPLE_MAX);
  const stars = [];
  const clouds = [];
  const palms = [];
  const veg = [];
  const rocks = [];

  function mulberry32(seed) {
    return function () {
      seed |= 0;
      seed = (seed + 0x6d2b79f5) | 0;
      let t = Math.imul(seed ^ (seed >>> 15), 1 | seed);
      t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t;
      return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
    };
  }

  function makeSmokeSprite(r, g, b, a0) {
    const s = document.createElement("canvas");
    s.width = 64;
    s.height = 64;
    const c = s.getContext("2d");
    const grd = c.createRadialGradient(32, 32, 2, 32, 32, 30);
    grd.addColorStop(0, "rgba(" + r + "," + g + "," + b + "," + a0 + ")");
    grd.addColorStop(0.32, "rgba(" + r + "," + g + "," + b + "," + (a0 * 0.55) + ")");
    grd.addColorStop(0.68, "rgba(" + r + "," + g + "," + b + "," + (a0 * 0.18) + ")");
    grd.addColorStop(1, "rgba(" + r + "," + g + "," + b + ",0)");
    c.fillStyle = grd;
    c.fillRect(0, 0, 64, 64);
    return s;
  }

  function makeGlowSprite(r, g, b, size) {
    const s = document.createElement("canvas");
    s.width = size;
    s.height = size;
    const c = s.getContext("2d");
    const m = size / 2;
    const grd = c.createRadialGradient(m, m, 0, m, m, m);
    grd.addColorStop(0, "rgba(" + r + "," + g + "," + b + ",1)");
    grd.addColorStop(0.35, "rgba(" + r + "," + g + "," + b + ",0.55)");
    grd.addColorStop(1, "rgba(" + r + "," + g + "," + b + ",0)");
    c.fillStyle = grd;
    c.fillRect(0, 0, size, size);
    return s;
  }

  function initSprites() {
    smokeSprites.length = 0;
    smokeSprites.push(makeSmokeSprite(245, 245, 248, 0.82));
    smokeSprites.push(makeSmokeSprite(210, 208, 204, 0.78));
    smokeSprites.push(makeSmokeSprite(160, 156, 150, 0.72));
    smokeSprites.push(makeSmokeSprite(120, 118, 114, 0.68));
    smokeSprites.push(makeSmokeSprite(255, 236, 210, 0.55));
    emberSprite = makeGlowSprite(255, 170, 40, 16);
    sparkSprite = makeGlowSprite(255, 240, 180, 12);
  }

  function resetPool(pool, n, factory) {
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) pool[i] = factory();
  }

  function smokeParticle() {
    return {
      alive: false, x: 0, y: 0, vx: 0, vy: 0,
      r: 10, growth: 18, life: 0, maxLife: 2,
      rot: 0, rotv: 0, sprite: 1, drag: 0.985, wind: 0, layer: 0
    };
  }

  function emberParticle() {
    return {
      alive: false, x: 0, y: 0, vx: 0, vy: 0,
      life: 0, maxLife: 1, size: 3, g: 80
    };
  }

  function rippleParticle() {
    return { alive: false, x: 0, y: 0, r: 4, vr: 22, life: 0, maxLife: 2.2 };
  }

  function spawnFrom(pool, apply) {
    for (let i = 0; i < pool.length; i++) {
      if (!pool[i].alive) {
        apply(pool[i]);
        pool[i].alive = true;
        return pool[i];
      }
    }
    return null;
  }

  function layout() {
    return {
      horizon: H * 0.575,
      islandX: W * 0.48,
      islandY: H * 0.73,
      islandRx: Math.min(W * 0.28, 340),
      islandRy: Math.min(H * 0.095, 88),
      padX: W * 0.475,
      padY: H * 0.705,
      towerX: W * 0.475 + 58
    };
  }

  function seedWorld() {
    const rng = mulberry32(0xC0DE46);
    stars.length = 0;
    const starCount = Math.floor(90 + W * 0.08);
    for (let i = 0; i < starCount; i++) {
      stars.push({
        x: rng(),
        y: rng() * 0.48,
        s: 0.4 + rng() * 1.6,
        ph: rng() * Math.PI * 2,
        sp: 0.6 + rng() * 2.4,
        a: 0.35 + rng() * 0.65
      });
    }
    clouds.length = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
      clouds.push({
        x: rng() * 1.2 - 0.1,
        y: 0.08 + rng() * 0.32,
        s: 0.55 + rng() * 0.9,
        sp: 0.003 + rng() * 0.006,
        tint: rng()
      });
    }
    palms.length = 0;
    palms.push({ side: -1, ox: -0.62, oy: 0.15, sc: 1.05, ph: 0.2 });
    palms.push({ side: 1, ox: 0.72, oy: 0.28, sc: 0.88, ph: 1.4 });
    palms.push({ side: -1, ox: -0.28, oy: 0.42, sc: 0.72, ph: 2.6 });
    veg.length = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < 28; i++) {
      veg.push({
        a: rng() * Math.PI * 2,
        d: 0.15 + rng() * 0.78,
        r: 8 + rng() * 22,
        g: 70 + rng() * 70,
        shade: rng()
      });
    }
    rocks.length = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
      rocks.push({
        a: rng() * Math.PI * 2,
        d: 0.55 + rng() * 0.4,
        w: 7 + rng() * 16,
        h: 4 + rng() * 8
      });
    }
  }

  function resize() {
    dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
    W = window.innerWidth;
    H = window.innerHeight;
    canvas.width = Math.floor(W * dpr);
    canvas.height = Math.floor(H * dpr);
    canvas.style.width = W + "px";
    canvas.style.height = H + "px";
    seedWorld();
  }

  function smootherstep(t) {
    t = t < 0 ? 0 : t > 1 ? 1 : t;
    return t * t * t * (t * (t * 6 - 15) + 10);
  }

  function rocketMotion(t, L) {
    const padY = L.padY - 6;
    const offY = -H * 0.55;
    const fit = Math.min(1.2, Math.max(0.72, H / 860));
    let y = padY;
    let scale = fit;
    let thrusting = false;
    let ignite = 0;
    let shake = 0;
    let visible = true;

    if (t < 1.5) {
      thrusting = t > 0.28;
      ignite = t < 0.28 ? 0 : Math.min(1, (t - 0.28) / 0.45);
      shake = ignite * (2.2 + (t > 1.1 ? 1.4 : 0));
    } else if (t < 7) {
      thrusting = true;
      ignite = 1;
      const u = t - 1.5;
      const alt = 22 * u * u + 4 * u * u * u + 16 * u;
      y = padY - alt;
      scale = fit * Math.max(0.42, 1 - alt / (H * 1.55));
      shake = u < 2.6 ? 3.4 * (1 - u / 2.6) : 0.6;
    } else if (t < 12) {
      y = offY;
      scale = fit * 0.42;
      visible = false;
      shake = 0;
    } else if (t < 16.4) {
      const p = smootherstep((t - 12) / 4.4);
      y = offY + (padY - offY) * p;
      scale = fit * (0.42 + 0.58 * p);
      visible = true;
      shake = 0;
    } else {
      y = padY;
      scale = fit;
      visible = true;
    }

    return { x: L.padX, y: y, scale: scale, thrusting: thrusting, ignite: ignite, shake: shake, visible: visible };
  }

  function spawnLaunchFx(t, dt, rocket, L) {
    const thrusting = rocket.thrusting;
    const ex = rocket.x;
    const ey = rocket.y + 4 * rocket.scale;
    const sc = rocket.scale;

    if (t > 0.35 && t < 6.8) {
      const nRip = t < 4.2 ? 0.35 : 0.08;
      if (Math.random() < nRip * dt * 60) {
        spawnFrom(ripples, function (p) {
          p.x = L.islandX + (Math.random() - 0.5) * L.islandRx * 1.6;
          p.y = L.islandY + L.islandRy * (0.35 + Math.random() * 0.5);
          p.r = 6 + Math.random() * 10;
          p.vr = 18 + Math.random() * 16;
          p.life = 0;
          p.maxLife = 1.6 + Math.random() * 1.1;
        });
      }
    }

    if (!thrusting) return;

    const pre = t < 1.5;
    const lift = t >= 1.5 && t < 4;
    const ascent = t >= 4 && t < 7;
    const thin = t >= 6.2;

    let baseN = 0, trailN = 0, emberN = 0;
    if (pre) {
      baseN = 6;
      emberN = 2;
    } else if (lift) {
      baseN = 9;
      trailN = 4;
      emberN = 4;
    } else if (ascent) {
      baseN = thin ? 1 : 3;
      trailN = thin ? 2 : 5;
      emberN = thin ? 1 : 3;
    }

    for (let i = 0; i < baseN; i++) {
      const ang = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
      const spread = pre ? 40 + Math.random() * 70 : 55 + Math.random() * 110;
      const mushroom = lift && Math.random() < 0.55;
      spawnFrom(smoke, function (p) {
        p.x = ex + Math.cos(ang) * (8 + Math.random() * 18) * sc;
        p.y = ey + 6 + Math.random() * 10;
        p.vx = Math.cos(ang) * spread * (0.35 + Math.random() * 0.7) + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 12;
        p.vy = mushroom
          ? -18 - Math.random() * 42
          : (pre ? -6 - Math.random() * 14 : -8 - Math.random() * 22);
        if (pre) p.vy *= 0.45;
        p.r = (mushroom ? 22 : 14) + Math.random() * 18;
        p.growth = 28 + Math.random() * 48;
        p.life = 0;
        p.maxLife = 2.2 + Math.random() * 2.4;
        p.rot = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
        p.rotv = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.7;
        p.sprite = t < 2.2 && Math.random() < 0.25 ? 4 : (Math.random() < 0.45 ? 0 : (Math.random() < 0.5 ? 1 : 2));
        p.drag = 0.978 + Math.random() * 0.012;
        p.wind = 6 + Math.random() * 10;
        p.layer = 0;
      });
    }

    for (let i = 0; i < trailN; i++) {
      spawnFrom(smoke, function (p) {
        p.x = ex + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 22 * sc;
        p.y = ey + 10 + Math.random() * 28;
        p.vx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 22;
        p.vy = 8 + Math.random() * 26;
        p.r = 8 + Math.random() * 12;
        p.growth = 16 + Math.random() * 28;
        p.life = 0;
        p.maxLife = 1.6 + Math.random() * 1.8;
        p.rot = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
        p.rotv = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.9;
        p.sprite = Math.random() < 0.3 ? 0 : (Math.random() < 0.5 ? 1 : 3);
        p.drag = 0.982;
        p.wind = 8 + Math.random() * 8;
        p.layer = 1;
      });
    }

    for (let i = 0; i < emberN; i++) {
      const a = Math.PI * 0.5 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.4;
      const sp = 40 + Math.random() * 120;
      spawnFrom(embers, function (p) {
        p.x = ex + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 16 * sc;
        p.y = ey + 8;
        p.vx = Math.cos(a) * sp * (Math.random() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1) * 0.35 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 80;
        p.vy = 30 + Math.random() * 90;
        p.life = 0;
        p.maxLife = 0.45 + Math.random() * 0.7;
        p.size = 1.2 + Math.random() * 2.8;
        p.g = 90 + Math.random() * 80;
      });
    }
  }

  function updateParticles(dt, t) {
    const breeze = 14 + Math.sin(t * 0.35) * 6;
    for (let i = 0; i < smoke.length; i++) {
      const p = smoke[i];
      if (!p.alive) continue;
      p.life += dt;
      if (p.life >= p.maxLife) {
        p.alive = false;
        continue;
      }
      const k = p.life / p.maxLife;
      p.vx += (breeze * 0.15 + Math.sin(t * 1.7 + p.rot) * p.wind * 0.12) * dt;
      p.vy -= 6 * dt;
      p.vx *= Math.pow(p.drag, dt * 60);
      p.vy *= Math.pow(p.drag, dt * 60);
      p.x += p.vx * dt;
      p.y += p.vy * dt;
      p.rot += p.rotv * dt;
      p._k = k;
      p._size = p.r + p.growth * (0.25 + 0.75 * k);
      p._a = k < 0.1 ? k / 0.1 : 1 - (k - 0.1) / 0.9;
      p._a *= 0.92;
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < embers.length; i++) {
      const p = embers[i];
      if (!p.alive) continue;
      p.life += dt;
      if (p.life >= p.maxLife) {
        p.alive = false;
        continue;
      }
      p.vy += p.g * dt;
      p.vx *= 0.98;
      p.x += p.vx * dt;
      p.y += p.vy * dt;
      p._k = p.life / p.maxLife;
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < ripples.length; i++) {
      const p = ripples[i];
      if (!p.alive) continue;
      p.life += dt;
      if (p.life >= p.maxLife) {
        p.alive = false;
        continue;
      }
      p.r += p.vr * dt;
      p._k = p.life / p.maxLife;
    }
  }

  function drawSky(L, t) {
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, L.horizon + 8);
    g.addColorStop(0, "#05060f");
    g.addColorStop(0.18, "#0b1230");
    g.addColorStop(0.42, "#1c2a62");
    g.addColorStop(0.62, "#5a3d7a");
    g.addColorStop(0.78, "#c45c48");
    g.addColorStop(0.9, "#f08a4b");
    g.addColorStop(1, "#ffc17a");
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    const sun = ctx.createRadialGradient(W * 0.52, L.horizon + 10, 4, W * 0.52, L.horizon + 10, W * 0.48);
    sun.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255, 210, 120, 0.7)");
    sun.addColorStop(0.18, "rgba(255, 140, 70, 0.28)");
    sun.addColorStop(0.5, "rgba(180, 70, 90, 0.08)");
    sun.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");
    ctx.fillStyle = sun;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, L.horizon + 20);

    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(W * 0.52, L.horizon + 6, 22, Math.PI, 0);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffd9a0";
    ctx.fill();
    const halo = ctx.createRadialGradient(W * 0.52, L.horizon + 4, 8, W * 0.52, L.horizon + 4, 70);
    halo.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255, 220, 160, 0.45)");
    halo.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255, 180, 80, 0)");
    ctx.fillStyle = halo;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(W * 0.52, L.horizon + 4, 70, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  function drawStars(L, t) {
    for (let i = 0; i < stars.length; i++) {
      const s = stars[i];
      const y = s.y * L.horizon;
      const fade = 1 - Math.min(1, y / (L.horizon * 0.55));
      if (fade <= 0.05) continue;
      const tw = 0.55 + 0.45 * Math.sin(t * s.sp + s.ph);
      ctx.globalAlpha = s.a * fade * tw;
      ctx.fillStyle = "#e8eeff";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(s.x * W, y, s.s, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function drawCloud(cx, cy, sc, tint, t) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(cx, cy);
    ctx.scale(sc, sc * 0.62);
    const warm = 0.25 + tint * 0.5;
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(" + Math.floor(255 - warm * 30) + "," + Math.floor(228 - warm * 50) + "," + Math.floor(210 - warm * 20) + ",0.32)";
    const blobs = [
      [0, 0, 48], [-38, 8, 32], [40, 10, 30], [-18, -14, 26], [22, -12, 24], [8, 14, 28]
    ];
    ctx.beginPath();
    for (let i = 0; i < blobs.length; i++) {
      ctx.moveTo(blobs[i][0] + blobs[i][2], blobs[i][1]);
      ctx.arc(blobs[i][0], blobs[i][1], blobs[i][2], 0, Math.PI * 2);
    }
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawClouds(L, t) {
    for (let i = 0; i < clouds.length; i++) {
      const c = clouds[i];
      let x = ((c.x + t * c.sp) % 1.4) - 0.2;
      drawCloud(x * W, c.y * L.horizon, c.s * (0.7 + W / 1800), c.tint, t);
    }
  }

  function drawOcean(L, t, rocket) {
    const top = L.horizon;
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, top, 0, H);
    g.addColorStop(0, "#6aa0c4");
    g.addColorStop(0.08, "#2d5f86");
    g.addColorStop(0.35, "#143a58");
    g.addColorStop(1, "#071422");
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(0, top - 2, W, H - top + 2);

    ctx.save();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.rect(0, top - 4, W, 28);
    ctx.clip();
    const rg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, top - 4, 0, top + 22);
    rg.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255, 190, 120, 0.28)");
    rg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255, 140, 70, 0)");
    ctx.fillStyle = rg;
    ctx.fillRect(0, top - 4, W, 28);
    ctx.restore();

    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(180, 220, 255, 0.12)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
    for (let k = 0; k < 5; k++) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      const y0 = top + 18 + k * ((H - top) / 6);
      for (let x = 0; x <= W; x += 10) {
        const y = y0 + Math.sin(x * 0.018 + t * 1.3 + k) * (2.2 + k * 0.4)
          + Math.sin(x * 0.041 + t * 1.9 + k * 1.7) * 1.2;
        if (x === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y);
        else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
      }
      ctx.stroke();
    }

    if (rocket.ignite > 0.05 && rocket.y > L.horizon * 0.35) {
      const glow = ctx.createRadialGradient(L.padX, L.islandY + 8, 4, L.padX, L.islandY + 8, 160);
      const a = 0.22 * rocket.ignite * (rocket.thrusting ? 1 : 0.15);
      glow.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255, 160, 40, " + a + ")");
      glow.addColorStop(0.45, "rgba(255, 90, 20, " + a * 0.35 + ")");
      glow.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255, 80, 0, 0)");
      ctx.fillStyle = glow;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(L.padX, L.islandY + 10, 170, 36, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }

    for (let i = 0; i < ripples.length; i++) {
      const p = ripples[i];
      if (!p.alive) continue;
      const a = (1 - p._k) * 0.28;
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(230, 245, 255, " + a + ")";
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.4 * (1 - p._k);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(p.x, p.y, p.r, p.r * 0.28, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  }

  function drawIsland(L, t) {
    const { islandX: cx, islandY: cy, islandRx: rx, islandRy: ry } = L;

    ctx.save();
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(4, 18, 28, 0.45)";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(cx + 8, cy + 16, rx * 1.08, ry * 0.85, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();

    ctx.beginPath();
    const n = 10;
    for (let i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
      const a = (i / n) * Math.PI * 2 - Math.PI / 2;
      const wob = 1 + Math.sin(a * 3) * 0.07 + Math.cos(a * 5.2) * 0.045;
      const px = cx + Math.cos(a) * rx * wob;
      const py = cy + Math.sin(a) * ry * wob;
      if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(px, py);
      else ctx.lineTo(px, py);
    }
    ctx.closePath();
    const sand = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy - ry * 0.2, 10, cx, cy, rx);
    sand.addColorStop(0, "#e8c98a");
    sand.addColorStop(0.45, "#d4b06a");
    sand.addColorStop(0.78, "#c9a056");
    sand.addColorStop(1, "#a67c42");
    ctx.fillStyle = sand;
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(cx, cy + 2, rx * 0.78, ry * 0.68, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    const grass = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx - 10, cy - 8, 8, cx, cy, rx * 0.8);
    grass.addColorStop(0, "#4a8a3a");
    grass.addColorStop(0.5, "#2f6a28");
    grass.addColorStop(1, "#1e4a1c");
    ctx.fillStyle = grass;
    ctx.fill();

    for (let i = 0; i < veg.length; i++) {
      const v = veg[i];
      const x = cx + Math.cos(v.a) * rx * 0.72 * v.d;
      const y = cy + Math.sin(v.a) * ry * 0.62 * v.d;
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(" + (30 + v.shade * 40) + "," + v.g + "," + (24 + v.shade * 20) + ",0.85)";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(x, y, v.r, v.r * 0.55, v.a, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }

    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.28)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(cx, cy + 1, rx * 0.97, ry * 0.92, 0, 0.15, Math.PI - 0.15);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(cx, cy + 3, rx * 0.9, ry * 0.82, 0, 0.2, Math.PI - 0.2);
    ctx.stroke();

    for (let i = 0; i < rocks.length; i++) {
      const r = rocks[i];
      const x = cx + Math.cos(r.a) * rx * r.d;
      const y = cy + Math.sin(r.a) * ry * r.d * 0.85;
      ctx.fillStyle = "#6b5a4a";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(x, y, r.w, r.h, r.a, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.12)";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(x - 1, y - 1, r.w * 0.4, r.h * 0.35, r.a, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }

  function drawPalm(x, y, sc, t, ph) {
    const sway = Math.sin(t * 1.05 + ph) * 0.14;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(x, y);
    ctx.scale(sc, sc);
    ctx.rotate(sway * 0.15);

    ctx.strokeStyle = "#6b4423";
    ctx.fillStyle = "#8a5a2b";
    ctx.lineWidth = 7;
    ctx.lineCap = "round";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, 0);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(6 + sway * 20, -36, sway * 40, -78);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#c48a4a";
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-1, 0);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(4 + sway * 20, -36, sway * 40 - 2, -78);
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.translate(sway * 40, -78);
    ctx.rotate(sway);
    const fronds = 7;
    for (let i = 0; i < fronds; i++) {
      const a = -Math.PI * 0.85 + (i / (fronds - 1)) * Math.PI * 1.7;
      ctx.save();
      ctx.rotate(a);
      ctx.fillStyle = i % 2 === 0 ? "#1f6b28" : "#2d8a34";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(0, 0);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(18, -7, 42, 2 + Math.sin(t * 2 + i) * 2);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(18, 6, 0, 0);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(180, 255, 140, 0.25)";
      ctx.lineWidth = 0.8;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(0, 0);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(18, -2, 40, 2);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.restore();
    }
    ctx.fillStyle = "#3d7a22";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, 0, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawPalms(L, t) {
    for (let i = 0; i < palms.length; i++) {
      const p = palms[i];
      const x = L.islandX + p.ox * L.islandRx;
      const y = L.islandY + p.oy * L.islandRy;
      drawPalm(x, y, p.sc * (0.85 + L.islandRx / 400), t, p.ph);
    }
  }

  function drawPad(L, t, rocket) {
    const x = L.padX;
    const y = L.padY + 10;

    ctx.fillStyle = "#5a5854";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(x, y + 6, 54, 16, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.fillStyle = "#8a8680";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x - 48, y);
    ctx.lineTo(x + 48, y);
    ctx.lineTo(x + 40, y + 14);
    ctx.lineTo(x - 40, y + 14);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.fillStyle = "#3a3836";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(x, y + 2, 22, 7, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.strokeStyle = "#d4a017";
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    ctx.setLineDash([6, 4]);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(x, y + 4, 38, 10, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.setLineDash([]);

    ctx.fillStyle = "#2a2826";
    ctx.fillRect(x - 16, y - 4, 32, 5);

    if (rocket.ignite > 0) {
      const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(x, y, 2, x, y, 40);
      g.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255, 200, 80, " + (0.55 * rocket.ignite) + ")");
      g.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255, 80, 0, 0)");
      ctx.fillStyle = g;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(x, y, 40, 12, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }

  function drawTower(L, t) {
    const x = L.towerX;
    const base = L.padY + 12;
    const top = L.padY - 300;
    const w = 22;

    ctx.save();
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#6d7380";
    ctx.fillStyle = "#4a5160";
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;

    ctx.fillRect(x - w / 2, top, 4, base - top);
    ctx.fillRect(x + w / 2 - 4, top, 4, base - top);

    ctx.strokeStyle = "#8a93a3";
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
    for (let y = top + 18; y < base - 8; y += 22) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x - w / 2, y);
      ctx.lineTo(x + w / 2, y);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x - w / 2, y);
      ctx.lineTo(x + w / 2, y + 22);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x + w / 2, y);
      ctx.lineTo(x - w / 2, y + 22);
      ctx.stroke();
    }

    ctx.fillStyle = "#3d4452";
    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
      const py = top + 36 + i * 52;
      ctx.fillRect(x - w / 2 - 8, py, w + 16, 5);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#c45c28";
      ctx.fillRect(x - w / 2 - 8, py, 4, 5);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#3d4452";
    }

    ctx.fillStyle = "#2c3340";
    ctx.fillRect(x - 6, top - 28, 4, 32);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x - 4, top - 30, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#8892a4";
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.fillStyle = "#d4a017";
    ctx.fillRect(x - w / 2 - 2, base - 18, w + 4, 6);
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function roundRectPath(x, y, w, h, r) {
    const rr = Math.min(r, w / 2, h / 2);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + rr, y);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, rr);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, rr);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, rr);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, rr);
    ctx.closePath();
  }

  function bodyShade(x0, x1, c0, c1, c2) {
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(x0, 0, x1, 0);
    g.addColorStop(0, c0);
    g.addColorStop(0.28, c1);
    g.addColorStop(0.72, c2);
    g.addColorStop(1, c0);
    return g;
  }

  function drawEngineBell(ox, oy, s) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(ox, oy);
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(-s, 0, s, 0);
    g.addColorStop(0, "#5a3a22");
    g.addColorStop(0.3, "#c48a48");
    g.addColorStop(0.55, "#f0d090");
    g.addColorStop(1, "#6a4428");
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-s * 0.42, -s * 0.9);
    ctx.lineTo(s * 0.42, -s * 0.9);
    ctx.lineTo(s * 0.95, s * 0.85);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(0, s * 1.15, -s * 0.95, s * 0.85);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#1a0e08";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, s * 0.72, s * 0.72, s * 0.22, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255, 200, 120, 0.25)";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, s * 0.62, s * 0.35, s * 0.1, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawRocket(x, y, scale, t, thrusting, ignite) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(x, y);
    ctx.scale(scale, scale);

    const bw = 38;
    const hw = bw / 2;

    const fins = [
      { x: 0, z: 1 },
      { x: 0, z: -1 },
      { x: 1, z: 0 },
      { x: -1, z: 0 }
    ];
    for (let i = 0; i < fins.length; i++) {
      const f = fins[i];
      if (f.z < 0) continue;
      ctx.save();
      ctx.fillStyle = f.x === 0 ? "#1c1e24" : "#2a2d36";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(f.x * (hw - 2), -38);
      ctx.lineTo(f.x * (hw + 22), -8);
      ctx.lineTo(f.x * (hw + 18), 4);
      ctx.lineTo(f.x * (hw - 2), -18);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.18)";
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.restore();
    }

    const positions = [
      [0, 0], [-11, 3], [11, 3], [-7, 8], [7, 8],
      [-18, 6], [18, 6], [0, 9], [-14, -1], [14, -1]
    ];
    for (let i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
      drawEngineBell(positions[i][0] * 0.85, positions[i][1] + 8, 7.4);
    }

    ctx.fillStyle = "#1a1c22";
    roundRectPath(-hw - 1, -42, bw + 2, 28, 3);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = bodyShade(-hw, hw, "#2a2e38", "#4a5160", "#6a7384");
    roundRectPath(-hw, -40, bw, 22, 2);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.fillStyle = bodyShade(-hw, hw, "#c8c0b4", "#f4efe6", "#ffffff");
    roundRectPath(-hw, -186, bw, 146, 2);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(40, 36, 32, 0.18)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 0.7;
    for (let yb = -180; yb < -44; yb += 11) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(-hw + 2, yb);
      ctx.lineTo(hw - 2, yb);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-6, -184);
    ctx.lineTo(-6, -44);
    ctx.moveTo(8, -184);
    ctx.lineTo(8, -44);
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(30, 28, 26, 0.28)";
    for (let yb = -176; yb < -48; yb += 22) {
      for (let k = 0; k < 5; k++) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(-hw + 6 + k * 7, yb, 0.7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
      }
    }

    ctx.fillStyle = "#1a1c22";
    ctx.fillRect(-hw, -92, bw, 10);
    ctx.fillRect(-hw, -148, bw, 7);
    ctx.fillStyle = bodyShade(-hw, hw, "#0e1014", "#2a2e38", "#3a404c");
    ctx.fillRect(-hw + 1, -91, bw - 2, 8);

    ctx.fillStyle = "#c45c28";
    ctx.fillRect(-hw, -168, bw, 14);
    ctx.fillStyle = bodyShade(-hw, hw, "#8a3518", "#e07038", "#ffb078");
    ctx.fillRect(-hw + 1, -167, bw - 2, 12);

    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(0, -161);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#f4efe6";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, -5);
    ctx.lineTo(4.5, 4);
    ctx.lineTo(-4.5, 4);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.5)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 0.8;
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();

    ctx.fillStyle = "#1d4a8c";
    ctx.fillRect(-hw + 6, -132, 11, 8);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#c43c2c";
    ctx.fillRect(-hw + 6, -128, 11, 1.4);
    ctx.fillRect(-hw + 6, -125.2, 11, 1.4);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#f4efe6";
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
      ctx.fillRect(-hw + 7 + (i % 2) * 3, -131 + Math.floor(i / 2) * 2, 1.2, 1.2);
    }

    ctx.strokeStyle = "#3a3e48";
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(10, -110, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(7, -110);
    ctx.lineTo(13, -110);
    ctx.moveTo(10, -113);
    ctx.lineTo(10, -107);
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.fillStyle = "#2a2e36";
    roundRectPath(hw - 7, -180, 6, 132, 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.12)";
    ctx.fillRect(hw - 6, -178, 2, 128);

    ctx.fillStyle = "#1a1c22";
    roundRectPath(-hw - 1, -214, bw + 2, 16, 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = bodyShade(-hw, hw, "#2a303c", "#4a5468", "#6a7890");
    roundRectPath(-hw, -212, bw, 12, 1);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.35)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 0.6;
    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(-hw + 4 + i * 6, -212);
      ctx.lineTo(-hw + 4 + i * 6, -200);
      ctx.stroke();
    }

    ctx.fillStyle = bodyShade(-hw + 1, hw - 1, "#c8c0b4", "#f4efe6", "#ffffff");
    roundRectPath(-hw + 1, -268, bw - 2, 56, 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(40, 36, 32, 0.16)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 0.7;
    for (let yb = -262; yb < -216; yb += 10) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(-hw + 4, yb);
      ctx.lineTo(hw - 4, yb);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    ctx.fillStyle = "#1a1c22";
    ctx.fillRect(-hw + 1, -236, bw - 2, 5);

    ctx.fillStyle = "#4a90c4";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, -250, 3.2, 4.5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.45)";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(-0.8, -251, 1.2, 1.6, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.fillStyle = "#2a2e36";
    ctx.fillRect(hw - 8, -258, 4, 6);
    ctx.fillRect(-hw + 4, -258, 4, 6);

    const fairing = ctx.createLinearGradient(-hw, 0, hw, 0);
    fairing.addColorStop(0, "#2a3038");
    fairing.addColorStop(0.3, "#5a6574");
    fairing.addColorStop(0.7, "#8a96a8");
    fairing.addColorStop(1, "#3a4450");
    ctx.fillStyle = fairing;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-hw + 1, -268);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-hw + 2, -300, -8, -328);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(0, -338, 8, -328);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(hw - 2, -300, hw - 1, -268);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.25)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 0.8;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, -268);
    ctx.lineTo(0, -332);
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.fillStyle = "#c45c28";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-6, -326);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(0, -340, 6, -326);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(0, -332, -6, -326);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255, 160, 80, 0.35)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-hw, -40);
    ctx.lineTo(-hw, -268);
    ctx.stroke();

    function gridFin(side) {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(side * (hw + 1), -190);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#2c313c";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.rect(0, -11, side * 17, 22);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = "#8a93a3";
      ctx.lineWidth = 0.7;
      ctx.stroke();
      for (let g = 0; g < 5; g++) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(side * 1.5, -9 + g * 4.5);
        ctx.lineTo(side * 15.5, -9 + g * 4.5);
        ctx.stroke();
      }
      for (let g = 0; g < 4; g++) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(side * (3.5 + g * 3.5), -10);
        ctx.lineTo(side * (3.5 + g * 3.5), 10);
        ctx.stroke();
      }
      ctx.restore();
    }
    gridFin(-1);
    gridFin(1);

    ctx.fillStyle = "#1c1e24";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-hw + 2, -38);
    ctx.lineTo(-hw - 20, -8);
    ctx.lineTo(-hw - 16, 4);
    ctx.lineTo(-hw + 2, -18);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(hw - 2, -38);
    ctx.lineTo(hw + 20, -8);
    ctx.lineTo(hw + 16, 4);
    ctx.lineTo(hw - 2, -18);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawFlame(x, y, scale, ignite, t) {
    if (ignite <= 0.02) return;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(x, y + 8 * scale);
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = "lighter";
    const flick = 0.82 + 0.18 * Math.sin(t * 53.1) * Math.sin(t * 37.7 + 1.2);
    const flick2 = 0.85 + 0.15 * Math.sin(t * 71.4 + 0.7);
    const len = (48 + ignite * 92) * flick * scale;
    const wid = (16 + ignite * 14) * flick2 * scale;

    function plume(yy, w, h, color) {
      ctx.fillStyle = color;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(-w * 0.35, yy);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-w, yy + h * 0.35, 0, yy + h);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(w, yy + h * 0.35, w * 0.35, yy);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
    }

    plume(0, wid * 1.7, len * 1.15, "rgba(255, 40, 10, " + (0.28 * ignite) + ")");
    plume(0, wid * 1.25, len * 0.95, "rgba(255, 110, 20, " + (0.45 * ignite) + ")");
    plume(0, wid * 0.8, len * 0.72, "rgba(255, 190, 40, " + (0.7 * ignite) + ")");
    plume(0, wid * 0.42, len * 0.5, "rgba(255, 250, 210, " + (0.9 * ignite) + ")");

    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255, 255, 255, " + (0.55 * ignite * flick) + ")";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, 6 * scale, 7 * scale, 10 * scale, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
      const dy = (18 + i * 14) * scale * flick;
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255, 240, 180, " + (0.25 * ignite * flick2) + ")";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(Math.sin(t * 40 + i) * 3 * scale, dy, 4 * scale, 3 * scale, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }

    ctx.restore();
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = "source-over";
  }

  function drawHeatHaze(x, y, scale, ignite, t) {
    if (ignite < 0.2) return;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = "lighter";
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.08 * ignite;
    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
      const ox = Math.sin(t * 18 + i * 1.3) * 10 * scale;
      ctx.fillStyle = i % 2 ? "rgba(255, 180, 80, 1)" : "rgba(255, 120, 40, 1)";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(x + ox, y + 20 * scale + i * 7, 18 * scale + i * 3, 5 * scale, Math.sin(t * 9 + i) * 0.4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawSmoke(layer) {
    for (let i = 0; i < smoke.length; i++) {
      const p = smoke[i];
      if (!p.alive || p._a < 0.02 || p.layer !== layer) continue;
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(p.x, p.y);
      ctx.rotate(p.rot);
      ctx.globalAlpha = p._a;
      const spr = smokeSprites[p.sprite] || smokeSprites[1];
      const sz = p._size;
      ctx.drawImage(spr, -sz, -sz, sz * 2, sz * 2);
      ctx.restore();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function drawEmbers() {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = "lighter";
    for (let i = 0; i < embers.length; i++) {
      const p = embers[i];
      if (!p.alive) continue;
      const a = 1 - p._k;
      ctx.globalAlpha = a;
      const sz = p.size * (1.2 - p._k * 0.6);
      ctx.drawImage(emberSprite, p.x - sz * 2, p.y - sz * 2, sz * 4, sz * 4);
      ctx.drawImage(sparkSprite, p.x - sz, p.y - sz, sz * 2, sz * 2);
    }
    ctx.restore();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function drawVignette() {
    const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(W * 0.5, H * 0.45, H * 0.2, W * 0.5, H * 0.5, H * 0.78);
    g.addColorStop(0, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");
    g.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,0.42)");
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  }

  function drawTitle() {
    const text = "Cursor Grok 4.6";
    ctx.save();
    ctx.font = "600 13px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255, 244, 230, 0.62)";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    const tracking = 5.5;
    let total = 0;
    const widths = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++) {
      const w = ctx.measureText(text[i]).width + tracking;
      widths.push(w);
      total += w;
    }
    let x = W / 2 - total / 2;
    const y = 32;
    for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++) {
      ctx.fillText(text[i], x, y);
      x += widths[i];
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function killAll() {
    for (let i = 0; i < smoke.length; i++) smoke[i].alive = false;
    for (let i = 0; i < embers.length; i++) embers[i].alive = false;
    for (let i = 0; i < ripples.length; i++) ripples[i].alive = false;
  }

  function frame(now) {
    const dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - lastNow) / 1000);
    lastNow = now;
    const t = ((now - start) / 1000) % CYCLE;
    if (t < lastCycleT) killAll();
    lastCycleT = t;

    const L = layout();
    const rocket = rocketMotion(t, L);

    spawnLaunchFx(t, dt, rocket, L);
    updateParticles(dt, t);

    ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#050814";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    const sh = rocket.shake;
    const sx = sh ? (Math.random() - 0.5) * sh : 0;
    const sy = sh ? (Math.random() - 0.5) * sh : 0;

    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(sx, sy);

    drawSky(L, t);
    drawStars(L, t);
    drawClouds(L, t);
    drawOcean(L, t, rocket);
    drawIsland(L, t);
    drawPalms(L, t);
    drawTower(L, t);
    drawPad(L, t, rocket);

    drawSmoke(1);

    if (rocket.visible) {
      if (rocket.thrusting) {
        drawFlame(rocket.x, rocket.y, rocket.scale, rocket.ignite, t);
        drawHeatHaze(rocket.x, rocket.y, rocket.scale, rocket.ignite, t);
      }
      drawRocket(rocket.x, rocket.y, rocket.scale, t, rocket.thrusting, rocket.ignite);
      if (rocket.thrusting) {
        drawFlame(rocket.x, rocket.y, rocket.scale * 0.55, rocket.ignite * 0.85, t + 0.2);
      }
    }

    drawEmbers();
    drawSmoke(0);

    ctx.restore();

    drawVignette();
    drawTitle();

    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }

  initSprites();
  resetPool(smoke, SMOKE_MAX, smokeParticle);
  resetPool(embers, EMBER_MAX, emberParticle);
  resetPool(ripples, RIPPLE_MAX, rippleParticle);
  resize();
  window.addEventListener("resize", resize);
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
})();
  </script>
</body>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />

  <title>Cursor Grok 4.6</title>
  <style>
    * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
    html, body {
      width: 100%;

      display: block;
      width: 100%;
